notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Plains.
description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Ornithopter, untapping the Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the Plains.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
